title: Summary
description: A TaskFlow summary produced by the management agent or created manually from an email, Slack thread, or document.

SummarySection.title: SummarySection
SummarySection.description: A structured section extracted from the summary raw text.

id.description: Stable identifier for this section within the summary.

body.description: Full prose body of the section.

extractedBullets.description: Agent-extracted bullet points from the section body.

SummaryStructured.title: SummaryStructured
SummaryStructured.description: Machine-readable structured data extracted by the agent from the raw summary text.

requester.description: Name of the primary requester or meeting organiser, if identified.

requesterContact.description: Contact info (email, Slack handle) of the requester, if identified.

mainAsk.description: One-sentence description of the main ask or decision needed.

deadline.description: Natural-language or ISO-8601 deadline extracted from the source.

risks.description: Risks or blockers identified in the summary.

dependencies.description: External dependencies mentioned in the summary.

sections.description: Ordered list of structured sections extracted from the source.

id.description: MongoDB ObjectId hex string (mapped from _id). Assigned by the server.

userId.description: Owning user ID. Sourced from the verified JWT — never from the client body.

sourceType.description: System or channel the summary originated from.

sourceRefs.description: IDs of SourceRef documents that back this summary.

rawText.description: Unmodified source text. Treat as potentially sensitive; do not log.

suggestedPriority.description: Priority level suggested by the agent when creating this summary.

reviewNeeded.description: True when the agent believes the user should review this summary before acting.

actionNeeded.description: True when the agent has identified one or more concrete action items.

taskCandidateIds.description: IDs of task-candidate objects proposed by the agent but not yet accepted.

linkedTaskIds.description: IDs of Task documents created from this summary.

archivedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this summary was archived, if applicable.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 creation timestamp. Set by the server.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 last-update timestamp. Maintained by the server on every write.
